collection.title: Suzuki Jimny 1998 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Suzuki Jimny 1998 - 2017 will fit, this model requires a 18" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade,  we also have rear blade for this Jimny, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
